description: 臺中市定時定點垃圾收運地點 [waste management] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺中市政府環境保護局. 本市自縣市合併以來，轄區遼闊共包含28區清潔隊，為提供市民即時查詢垃圾清潔車位置及設定到清運點前之主動提醒服務，並有效管理車輛動態，本計畫擬運用全球衛星定位系統、無線通訊及地理資訊系統等科技，將車輛、人員、路線、清運狀況等相關資料及其即時訊息，整合建置於「清潔車即時衛星定位便民查詢及管理系統」中，以提升為民服務品質及車輛動態管理效率之目標... Coverage: 臺中市政府環境保護局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺中市政府環境保護局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json, csv. The portal shows 2026-07-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
